europe_now.title: French intelligence chief warns of escalating hostile action after Leipzig drone attack
europe_now.summary: France's intelligence director has warned of further 'violent, hostile action' following a drone attack in Leipzig. The alert signals heightened concerns about sabotage and hybrid threats targeting European infrastructure.

sources.headline: French intelligence chief warns of more ‘violent, hostile action’ after Leipzig drone attack

europe_now.title: Hungary officially declares Russia a threat, breaking with Orbán-era policy
europe_now.summary: Hungary's government has formally designated Russia as a threat, marking a significant departure from the foreign policy stance maintained under Viktor Orbán. The declaration signals a realignment in Budapest's security posture toward Moscow.

sources.headline: Hungary declares Russia a ‘threat’, breaking with Orbán policy

top_stories.title: France and Germany at odds over European clean industrial policy
top_stories.summary: France and Germany have clashed over the direction of European clean industrial policy, exposing divisions between the EU's two largest economies on strategy and investment priorities. The dispute comes as the European Union weighs its approach to industrial decarbonization and competitiveness.

sources.headline: La France et l’Allemagne se divisent sur le développement de l’industrie propre en Europe

top_stories.title: Migration pressures continue at Spain's Ceuta border enclave
top_stories.summary: Hundreds of migrants remain at Spain's Ceuta enclave as authorities process asylum claims and confront persistent disinformation campaigns surrounding the situation. The case highlights ongoing border management challenges for the European Union's external frontiers.

sources.headline: 'In Ceuta, they are eating the cats': Fake images and a persistent rumour
Holding out in Ceuta until asylum is granted

top_stories.title: First fully autonomous drone kill reported in Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Ukraine has reported the first confirmed fully autonomous drone kill on the battlefield, an event observers describe as a milestone heralding a 'dystopian future of untethered weaponry.' The development raises urgent questions about the regulation of autonomous weapons systems.

sources.headline: First fully-autonomous drone kill Ukraine heralds ‘dystopian future of untethered weaponry’

top_stories.title: Turkey defies European Court of Human Rights ruling on Kavala
top_stories.summary: Turkey continues to defy the European Court of Human Rights by keeping activist Osman Kavala detained despite Strasbourg's binding ruling. The standoff underscores ongoing tensions between Ankara and the continent's human rights institutions.

sources.headline: Turkey is defying Europe’s human-rights court — and Osman Kavala is paying the price
